points.description: TCP congestion control has two phases: slow start and congestion avoidance.
In slow start, cwnd increases by one segment for each acknowledged segment, so it roughly doubles every RTT (exponential growth).
Slow start ends and congestion avoidance begins when cwnd reaches ss_thresh.
In congestion avoidance, cwnd grows linearly, by about one segment per RTT.
On a packet loss, ss_thresh is set to half of the current cwnd.
On a packet loss, cwnd is reset to 1 and slow start is entered again.
